name: Data Rescue
summary: In Gnomeregan, the fallen city's records lie beyond troggs and radiation. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge sends you to recover a Prismatic Punch Card through the terminals' layers of clearance.

sections.title: Lost Archives of the Underground
sections.body: Gnomeregan's fall to troggs and radiation drove its people from the city, leaving centuries of research, schematics, and civic records behind. Matrix Punchograph terminals still line its technological corridors, managing security clearance and storing files. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge's Tinker Town wants those punch-encoded archives recovered from the city's depths.

sections.title: A Hierarchy of Perforations
sections.body: Gnomish mainframes demand clearance in stages. Begin with a White Punch Card among the wreckage outside the inner gates. Insert it into the Matrix Punchograph 3005-A in the Train Depot to make a Yellow card, then take that to the 3005-B terminal in the Dormitory for a Blue card. Model 3005-C advances it to Red. The final terminal, 3005-D, waits in the Engineering Labs, where the Red card becomes a Prismatic Punch Card.

sections.title: Gnomish Levity in Binary
sections.body: Gnomeregan's punch cards carry more than technical records. Their binary patterns also hold humorous quips, workplace complaints, and off-color jokes about High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque wearing night elven undergarments. Even the city's computing guilds could not resist a practical joke.

faq.q: What is the Prismatic Punch Card?
faq.answer: The Prismatic Punch Card is the highest security tier recognized by Gnomeregan's automated mainframes. The Matrix Punchograph 3005-D in the Engineering Labs creates it from a Red Punch Card.

faq.q: Where does the sequence of punch cards begin?
aliases: where to get white punch card
faq.answer: The sequence begins with a White Punch Card salvaged from troggs and mechanical derelicts outside the main entrance, near the Train Depot.

faq.q: Where are the Matrix Punchograph terminals located?
faq.answer: The Matrix Punchograph 3005-A is in the Train Depot outside the entrance. Model 3005-B is inside the Dormitory past the Clean Zone, and 3005-C is on the catwalk platforms beyond. Model 3005-D is on the lower level of the Engineering Labs.
Master Mechanic Castpipe is a senior gnome engineer among the refugees in Ironforge's Tinker Town. He coordinates efforts to recover Gnomeregan's intellectual heritage from the fallen capital.

faq.q: What data is actually on the cards?
faq.answer: The cards contain critical computational data alongside gnomish engineering banter, lighthearted jokes about regional leaders like Thrall and Mekkatorque, and eccentric notes.

faq.q: Can Horde players access these terminals?
faq.answer: Master Mechanic Castpipe offers this work only to the Alliance in Ironforge. The punchograph terminals inside the dungeon can be used by anyone carrying the required cards.

angles.text: As a gnome, recovering Gnomeregan's data helps reclaim your people's heritage. Each salvaged punch card preserves your city's ingenuity from troggs and radiation.
As an engineer, you can study how the Matrix Punchograph network stores data and uses intricate clearance mechanisms devised by the Tinkers' Court.
As an Alliance member, helping Castpipe supports the displaced gnomish government in Ironforge and strengthens unity and technological capabilities among the Grand Alliance.
